question: Why does the deity praise the goddess for her difficult question?
premises: The deity expresses strong approval to the great goddess
The deity has been asked a question
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods
inference: The deity praises the goddess because she has asked about something rare and difficult even for the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess! I have been asked about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
